Manual pixel reading: 19 printed text rows = 16 exercise rows + 2 captions + 1 folio. Figure-internal lettering is inside figure boxes and not counted as body text. This is an observed count, not a pipeline counter result.

Figure 29 [120,225,1130,185] includes the entire row of fifteen subfigures and labels; it belongs to exercise 70 on physical p0035. Caption box [610,420,120,40]. Figure 30 [135,625,1120,265] includes all three point groups, including the otherwise unlabelled isolated mark in the right group. Caption box [625,900,115,45]. Boxes are coarse and unsnapped.

Exercise 72 has a raised solid round mark near [175,964,15,15], transcribed as a superscript bullet. The pixels do not establish whether this was a deliberately round marker or an ink-filled asterisk; the mark is not silently discarded.

Exercise 76's heavy numeral initially resembled 78 at page scale; a 3x clean-source crop [120,1300,330,550], saved as source-number-detail.png, resolves the numeral as 76. The crop also shows the later distinct 78 numeral. Asterisks are visible for 76 and 77.

Exercise 76 breaks between the printed 2 and cm; the line break is preserved rather than moving cm to the preceding line. Exercise 78 finishes its sentence on this page and references figure 31 on the next page, so no empty ex cont block is needed.
